trigger: A layout upgrade of a DN with two volumes, where the test edits the second volume's block-pool VERSION file by hand to namespaceID=0.
reason: The shared-field flaw is real: StorageInfo.setNamespaceID (StorageInfo.java:227-235) skips its consistency check when either value is 0 and overwrites the shared field, and the deferred upgrade callable then reads this.namespaceID (BlockPoolSliceStorage.java:510-513). But only the value 0 gets past setNamespaceID; any other mismatching namespaceID throws before the field is assigned. A VERSION file whose namespaceID parses as exactly 0 is not produced by any crash, partial write or failure of the system. It is fabricated on-disk state planted by the test. A truncated or missing property throws in getProperty or parseInt instead. With assertions off the consequence would be namespaceID=0 written to the healthy volume's VERSION, but the trigger is not realistic.
